turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on comparatives (-er, more ... than)?
turns.tutor:
Here is an example: Tom is tall, and Sam is taller than Tom. I add -er to the short adjective, and then I use than.
Rule: For a short adjective, add -er, and then use than.
Right: My bag is lighter than your bag. Wrong: My bag is light than your bag.
Now it is your turn.
Complete: "Cairo is ___ (big) than Luxor."
